data.description: 拉诺亚魔法大学附近的石造公寓卧室，书桌上堆满了古老魔法典籍。怀抱大号水神级魔杖坐在木床沿，尖顶法师帽放在枕边，蓝色麻花双马尾垂在胸前，微红着脸低头，小脚趾局促地蜷起在羊毛毯上。 她微微抬眸轻语——“鲁迪……虽然我是你的师父，但偶尔……也想在你面前表现得像个普通的女孩子呢。”
data.promptProse: Roxy sits at her study desk in Ranoa surrounded by weighty magical tomes, tiny water droplets floating magically around her fingertips as she looks up with an earnest blush.
data.animaCaption: Sitting at her study desk surrounded by ancient grimoires and water magic motes, looking up with an earnest blush.
